status: Lead-authorized bounded decisive follow-up frozen before opening individual PFS cells
specific_claim: Original authors suggest this series may serve as an external control in new-agent clinical studies. No assertion that its response observations or published PFS estimate are wrong.
cohort: All original 11 native author/molecularly supported EMC rows, IDs1–11. No additional cohorts, donor pooling or responder selection.
common_origin_rule: Require source-explicit treatment-start origin for individual PFS intervals and common units. PFS name alone is not accepted as explicit start-date confirmation. Calendar dates are not imputed. If definition absent, report non-identifiability and no event-time estimate.

event_mapping_rule.surgery: Asterisk in the PFS cell is accepted as complete-surgery conversion because the exact footnote explicitly defines it. Surgery is separate from progression/death.
event_mapping_rule.progression_or_death: Require explicit source case-linked endpoint status or a source-defined unambiguous table coding. Best RECIST response is not final progression/death status; a plain duration is not automatically an event.
event_mapping_rule.ordinary_censor: Require explicit source case-linked last-contact/status or source-defined coding. Do not guess plus/greater-than symbols or assign nonasterisk durations as events.
event_mapping_rule.unknown: Retain exact source field and unknown state; never infer from response, treatment duration, age/site or other sources. Stop competing-event numerical estimation if any required individual mapping is ambiguous.

six_month_landmark: The existing EMC systemic-study literature uses six-month PFS as a design/benchmark landmark; select six months before individual values. Do not import its numerical null or incompatible cohort as comparator.
estimands_if_identified: Aalen–Johansen cumulative incidence by six source-defined months for first progression/death
Aalen–Johansen cumulative incidence by six source-defined months for first complete surgery
Probability without either recorded event at six months; distinct from hypothetical no-surgery PFS and no claim of failure or treatment efficacy
missingness_policy: No omitted row, donor pooling, imputed origin/date/event type or death versus progression split. Missing appropriate mappings prevent estimation; retain pending suitable public evidence rather than exclude it.
hypothetical_no_surgery_bounds: Only if all origins/ordinary censor states are authentic: report partial-identification limits for progression/death among surgery conversions by six months, with surgery not counted as progression. No counterfactual trajectory is observed; arbitrary best/worst surgery trajectories are sensitivity bounds, not estimates. If unresolved ordinary censoring also prevents finite-cohort identification, report no bound rather than manufacture precision.
uncertainty: If a fully identified independent-row cohort permits calculation, report exact source risk sets/event counts and a finite-sample bootstrap interval for each empirical CIF using fixed seed20261005 and10000 donor resamples. Small selected cohort limits generalization; bootstrap is descriptive conditional sampling uncertainty only. No p-value or external drug comparison.
disproof_and_value_stop: No explicit common origin or per-row event/censor map
No uncertainty-resolved clinical consequence beyond generic informative-surgery caution
Only rephrases authors already reported complete surgery/postoperative recurrence
Suitable unresolved broader clinical evidence or donor overlap prevents advancement
prior_exposure: R7 already evaluated individual cells historically; this worker reused R7 aggregate outcomes and read Methods/Discussion/Conclusions, and its helper exposed broader-cohort aggregate outcomes. No full-team or full-outcome blinding claim. These new source PFS cells have not been opened by this worker before this freeze.
clinical_interpretation_limit: Even successful empirical CIF decomposition does not establish benefit, causal effect, external-control exchangeability or universal EMC outcomes. Do not count beneficial surgery as progression.
authorization: Lead message2026-10-05 authorizes this exact finite follow-through, not publication or manuscript. Independent radiotherapy reviewer challenges origin/event assumptions and value.
